description: This file defines the MultiPointStrategy class, which extends CacheStrategy to implement cache point placement logic for message caching in a system that handles multiple cache points based on token thresholds. It includes methods for determining optimal cache points, handling system and message cache support, and formatting cache results.

classes.name: MultiPointStrategy
classes.description: A class that manages cache point placement for message caching, supporting multiple cache points based on token thresholds, with logic for handling system and message cache support, and optimizing cache point locations.

methods.name: determineOptimalCachePoints
methods.description: Calculates and returns the optimal cache points based on current configuration and token thresholds.

methods.name: determineMessageCachePoints
methods.description: Determines cache point placements within message sequences, considering previous placements and token counts.

methods.name: findOptimalPlacementForRange
methods.description: Finds the best cache point placement within a message range, typically the last user message that meets token criteria.

methods.name: formatWithoutCachePoints
methods.description: Formats and returns cache result when no cache points are used.
